svg.title: Figure 3. Regional impact
svg.desc: Figure 3. Left: the male central nervous system seen from the front, brain above and nerve cord below, each neuropil shaded by the share of flow capacity lost when all cell types anchored in it are removed; GNG is darkest. Right: the ten largest losses as bars with the mean loss of 200 same-size random sets marked: GNG 34.7%, LegNp(T3)(R) 15.4%, ANm 11.4%, SAD 10.6%, LegNp(T2)(L) 9.9%, LegNp(T2)(R) 9.8%, Ov(L) 9.2%, AL(R) 8.9%, LegNp(T3)(L) 7.8%, IntTct 7.6%. The gnathal ganglia lose 34.7% against 20.6% for random sets, p = 0.005. 14 of 91 neuropils exceed their null at uncorrected p below 0.05.
